## How to Commission

**Platform:** Upwork — Writing & Translation > Subtitles & Captions
**Job title:** "Audio Description Writer — Timed VTT Files for Short Film Clips (Public Domain)"
**Rate range:** $25–$45/audio minute or $75–$200/project per clip at mid-quality tier
**Strategy:** Post job first, then proactively invite from ADP directory at adp.acb.org/ad-professionals

**Quality signals to require:**
- Portfolio samples with timed VTT output (required)
- ADI/ADP certificate, or DCMP-compliant training
- Explicit mention of VTT/SRT timed output format

**Red flag:** Anything under $5/audio minute — too low for human-quality AD.

---

## Coverage gaps to fill

- No 5–15 min live-action narrative fiction with dense, dialogue-integrated AD
- Blender films (above) have no existing professional VTT — need to commission
- NFB short films have professional AD but require research access request
- LSMDC dataset requires NDA
